answers.core: This is about making it easier for developers to provide graphics settings in a way that doesn't affect the game's appearance too much, since artists can provide a good fallback out of the box.
answers.workaround: Yes, by looping through all nodes of type OmniLight3D or SpotLight3D in the scene tree and multiplying their color by a metadata property on scene load if projectors can't be used. However, this won't work if the shadows property is changed at runtime (which can especially occur if the shadow distance fade properties are used).

title: Add a fallback color modulate property for Light3D projectors
